scientificObservations: Panel (a) has three parallel incident rays. The off-axis rays bend inward, cross on the axis before the retina and reach the posterior boundary separated again; the axial ray stays straight. This is the stated relaxed-accommodation myopia model.

Panel (b) shows inward-pointing spectacle-lens tips. Parallel off-axis rays diverge between spectacle lens and eye, then converge at the posterior retina; the axial ray remains straight. The lens symbol and ray action agree.

A remains the open axial point left of the spectacle lens. Both dashed backward extensions are collinear with their corresponding post-lens rays and meet A, not the pre-retina focus of panel (a). This represents a finite far point, not a physical light source or a real image.

Matching the lens to the relaxed-accommodation eye is conditional in both modern languages and the visible note. The model is explicitly schematic; no prescription or anatomical propagation is inferred.
inventoryAndAssertions: Both independently inventoried source panels, three-ray bundles, rounded eyes, anterior bulges, posterior retina relationships, one spectacle lens, A and dashed/solid distinctions survive.

scientificObservations: Panel (a) preserves parallel incidence and rays still separated at the retina. Solid muted continuations meet behind it and are explicitly labeled as a would-focus construction, not physical transmission through a living retina.

Panel (b) has outward lens tips and off-axis rays bending toward the axis before entering the eye; the eye then brings them to the retina. This is converging spectacle correction in a matched focusing state, not a guarantee for any lens.

Panel (c) retains S1 left of S, both left of the outward-tip lens. Rays actually leave S. Their slopes after the lens remain divergent but smaller in magnitude than before it, while dashed backward extensions meet S1. The virtual image is farther from the eye, and the eye rays meet the retina.

The d guides and measure retain the S1-to-eye-front span. They do not measure S-to-lens or S1-to-retina. The 25 cm reference and d > 25 cm are qualified prose-derived example additions, not numerical givens found in the original pixels.

The modern text distinguishes relaxed distant focusing, possible accommodation compensation and conditional near viewing. It does not identify 25 cm with every person's near point or comfort, and does not provide lens-selection advice.
inventoryAndAssertions: All three independently inventoried panels, three-ray bundles, eyes, two converging lens symbols, S/S1, dashed virtual extensions, and the d span are present.
